name: Forms
description: Element type for web forms: a form editor with all usual fields (also uploads, conditions and checks), a layout as accessible grid or placed freely, storage of the submissions and further targets (property database, e-mail, workflow, webhook). Everyone who may see the form may submit it; what happens with a submission is done with the rights of the person who set the form up.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Create forms
permissions.description: Create forms and change or delete the own ones.

permissions.label: Forms administrator
permissions.description: Change and delete all forms of the category.

permissions.label: See submissions
permissions.description: See, export and delete the submissions of the forms of the category (the creator of a form always sees its submissions).

permissions.label: Send submissions outside
permissions.description: Send submissions to any e-mail address and to webhooks (without it only to members of the wiki).

limits.label: Size of a form submission
limits.help: Upper bound for one submission with all its files (also for guests). Each form allows at most the files its fields accept; this limit caps every form.
